map.计算折扣率、折扣后价格、节省金额等: Compute discount rate, discounted price, amount saved and more
map.📖 查看「折扣率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Discount Rate Calculator User Guide"
map.原价+折扣率→折后价: Original price + discount rate -> discounted price
map.原价+折后价→折扣率: Original price + discounted price -> discount rate
map.原价+省多少→折扣率: Original price + amount saved -> discount rate
map.如：30% off = 7折: For example: 30% off = pay 70% of price
map.折扣率是商品降价的比例，通常用百分比表示。例如30% discount（30%: A discount rate is the proportion by which a product's price is cut, usually shown as a percentage. For example 30% discount (30% off) means 30% off the original price, so the customer pays 70% of the price (a 7-zhe discount).
map.折后价 = 原价 × (1 - 折扣率%): Discounted price = original price × (1 - discount rate%)
map.节省金额 = 原价 × 折扣率%: Amount saved = original price × discount rate%
map.折扣率 = (1 - 折后价 ÷ 原价) × 100%: Discount rate = (1 - discounted price / original price) × 100%
map.例如：原价299元，折扣率30%，折后价 = 299 × 0.7 = 209.3: For example with an original price of 299 CNY and a 30% discount rate, discounted price = 299 × 0.7 = 209.3 CNY and saving = 299 × 0.3 = 89.7 CNY

map.实际折扣率可能与标称有差异，注意计算真实优惠力度: The effective discount rate can differ from the stated one, so work out the true size of the offer
map.注意「划线价」「原价」是否真实，警惕虚假打折: Check whether the struck-through price and original price are genuine and beware fake discounts
map.优惠券叠加规则：先打折再用券 vs 先用券再打折: Coupon stacking rules: discount first then coupon, or coupon first then discount

map.：为凑满减购买更多商品: : buying more items to reach the threshold

map.原价 299、打 8 折（折扣 20%）→ 折后价=299×(1−20%)=23: Original price 299 with a 20% discount (80% of price) gives discounted price = 299×(1−20%) = 239.2 CNY, a saving of 59.8 CNY.
map.由折后价反推: Working back from the discounted price
map.原价 299、折后 239.2 → 折扣率=(1−239.2/299)×100=: Original price 299 discounted to 239.2 gives discount rate = (1−239.2/299)×100 = 20%, i.e. 20% off.
map.折扣率和折扣力度一样吗？: Are discount rate and discount strength the same?
map.「打 8 折」折扣力度是 20%（省的比例），折扣率有时指最终占比 80%，表述: "A 20% discount" means the saving is 20% of the price, while the discount rate sometimes refers to the final 80% share; the wording is easily confused, so state plainly "save X%" or "pay Y% of price".
map.先算店铺折扣再减券，顺序影响最终价，本工具按「原价×折扣系数−券」口径，避免资损: Apply the store discount first and then subtract the coupon; the order changes the final price. This tool uses original price × discount factor − coupon to avoid giving away margin.
